% changebar given pdfTeX's driver option, with hyperref: bars from
% \cbstart and \cbend, from the changebar environment, and from
% \cbdelete, in italic, sans-serif, and typewriter text, in a footnote,
% in a theorem, and in a list; then changebar loaded again with the
% option, which is no clash. Each input's text is the same as without
% the option, where changebar's default driver shows no bars.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[pdftex]{changebar}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\RequirePackage[pdftex]{changebar}
\begin{document}
\section{Changes}\label{changes}

Before the bar. \cbstart Inside the bar, with \emph{italic},
\textsf{sans}, and \texttt{typewriter} text.\cbend{} After the bar.

\begin{changebar}
In the environment, with a link to section~\ref{changes}.
\end{changebar}
After the environment.

Deleted here.\cbdelete{} After the deletion.

A note.\footnote{\cbstart Note in a bar.\cbend{} After the note's bar.}
After the note.

\begin{theorem}
\cbstart A theorem in a bar.\cbend{} After the theorem's bar.
\end{theorem}

\begin{itemize}
\item \cbstart First item in a bar.\cbend
\item Second item.
\end{itemize}
After the list.
\end{document}
